lines.text: Sound judgment will be life to his soul, and he will not be afraid when he lies down.
He should not fear sudden danger, for the LORD will be his shield and keep his foot from the snare.
He must not withhold good from the deserving, or accuse a man without cause who has done him no harm.
He should not envy a violent man, for the LORD detests the perverse but blesses the home of the righteous.
The LORD gives grace to the humble, and the wise will inherit the earth.
